Resolves #19815

Refs #19810, #19812

> 🌿 A stack-return timeout used to end in a snapshot that named every surface and no decision; what became unsayable is "the proof cannot tell which conjunct refused main's zone".

The first CI red carrying #19812's proof (#19804, run 38914922511) showed main's target present, the pointer arbiter live at `claimCount 0` and both windows' rects sane — and still could not say whether main's zone was absent from the group, refused by ownership admission, outside its `innerRect` or refusing the hit-test. The coordinator records exactly that on every pass (`recordClaimResolution`). An unready read's `claimSurfaces.coordinator` now carries `claimTrace`: the live gesture's records, matched by each entry's stamped token, the last three, cloned; the owned records carry their `windowId`, so a record retained from an earlier take is distinguishable from the current vessel's; scene 5's assertion message prints the driver's `aimed` node and rect beside the snapshot. A ready read is unchanged, so the receipts the beat logs compare stay byte-identical. No behaviour changes; the fix is the follow-up the ticket names, filed from the first red that carries the record.

Evidence: L2 (the mixin's reader on a stubbed coordinator ring; scene 5 green headless on the author's seat with the new message) → L2 required (AC-1 is a read's shape, AC-2 a message's fields). Residual: none, Residual-Owner: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pr-body and substrate-size run in CI; `Workspace.spec.mjs` (103) and scene 5 ran on the seat.
